attchmntText: KNR Constructions Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: KNR Constructions Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call held on 16th November 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the link http://knrcl.com/transcriptofconcall.html. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The company has informed BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding this upload. The document was issued on 16th November 2026. Haritha Varanasi, Company Secretary, signed the communication.

attchmntText: KNR Constructions Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: KNR Constructions Limited filed its investor presentation for Q2FY27 with BSE and NSE. The company reported standalone revenue of Rs. 4,769.6 million and profit after tax of Rs. 2,807.6 million for the quarter. Consolidated revenue was Rs. 6,002.0 million with consolidated profit after tax of Rs. 1,021.1 million. Standalone EBITDA stood at Rs. 439.3 million. The profit increase was driven by an exceptional item of Rs. 2,925.4 million from the sale of a HAM project to Indus Infra Trust. The company received a letter of acceptance from HMDA for a project costing Rs. 1,396 Crores. Financial closure for a subsidiary HAM project was noted on 01st October 2026. CRISIL reaffirmed long-term bank facilities at CRISIL AA with a stable outlook. The order book stands at Rs. 1,17,088 million as of 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: KNR Constructions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: KNR Constructions Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the results on 13th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 78,965.7 lakhs for the quarter and 51,365.36 lakhs for the half year. Net profit after tax stood at 5,076.27 lakhs for the quarter and 56,304.45 lakhs for the half year. The half year profit included exceptional items of 57,786.93 lakhs from the transfer and surrender of subsidiary share capital. Total assets were 530,174.34 lakhs as at 30th September 2026. Cash and cash equivalents were 4,027.03 lakhs. The results include a limited review report.

attchmntText: KNR Constructions Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: KNR Constructions Limited has scheduled an investor conference call to discuss financial performance for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The call is set for Monday, 16th November 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. Participants include Mr. K. Jalandhar Reddy, Executive Director and CFO, and Mr. K Venkatram Rao, General Manager of Finance and Accounts. The company has informed the BSE and NSE of this schedule pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. Invitation copies are enclosed with the intimation. Pre-registration is requested via the provided link. Access numbers are listed for primary, toll-free USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong regions. Strategic Growth Advisors Pvt. Ltd. handles RSVPs through Mr. Jigar Kavaiya and Ms. Krunali Shah. Contact numbers are plus 91 99206 02034 and plus 91 98209 87564.
